definition: [ בָּזַר ] verb scatter (Arabic , Aramaic בְּדַר ) — Qal Imperfect Dan 11:24 בִּזָּה וְשָׁלָל וּרְכוּשׁ לָהֶם יִבְז֑וֺר plunder and spoil and possessions he will scatter among them (subject Antiochus Epiph.) Pi`el Perfect בִּזַּר , id. , Ps 68:31 , but read Imperative (בַּזַּר) בַּזֵּר ( ᵐ5 ᵑ6 ᵑ9 so most; De follows MT), subject reference to ׳ י , object עַמִּים .

[בָּזַר] verb scatter (Arabic , Aramaic בְּדַר) —

Qal Imperfect Dan 11:24 בִּזָּה וְשָׁלָל וּרְכוּשׁ לָהֶם יִבְז֑וֺר plunder and spoil and possessions he will scatter among them (subject Antiochus Epiph.) Pi`el Perfect בִּזַּר, id., Ps 68:31, but read Imperative (בַּזַּר) בַּזֵּר (ᵐ5 ᵑ6 ᵑ9 so most; De follows MT), subject reference to ׳י, object עַמִּים.
